scope: XOCE website native product screenshots and official Pebble Appstore device frame
notes: The original four versioned native captures remain unchanged. Four current-release captures were added on 2026-11-07 under new filenames; their native pixels are unchanged.
These are native emulator renderings, not physical-watch photography or browser design mock-ups.
Some presentations place unchanged native captures inside the official Pebble Appstore Time 2 frame; catalogue and documentation views may display the captures directly.
Dashboard reuses an older capture of its unchanged watch layout; that reuse is identified in its entry.
No new licence is granted by this provenance record; source-project licences and third-party notices remain authoritative.
Halftone 1.9.0-rc.6 native fixture screenshot and ČHMÚ Weather 1.0.1 original icon were added unchanged on 2026-11-12; the plugin icon is not a watch screenshot.

2026-11-12: Added 24 unchanged release-sourced gallery images. Current heroes use release-matched captures. Earlier image files and their historical records remain unchanged. Phone settings previews are classified separately from native watch captures.
2026-11-13: Launch-preview captures for the six Store releases. Native PNG bytes are unchanged; candidates are not presented as published releases. Historical records remain intact.

2026-11-13: Added the unchanged official Pebble Appstore Round 2 device frame at Xef's request, matching the existing Time 2 presentation. Native captures and the original frame record remain unchanged.
